name: gleif_lei-mcp
description: GLEIF LEI records (sales): me, search, get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No credentials; verified with a one-record listing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: JSON:API listing filtered by legal name and (optionally) legal-address country (ISO alpha-2, e.g. US). `id` is the LEI; `url` is the API record link (links.self) — no web page URL is documented. `address` is the first legal-address line; city/region/postalCode are under raw.attributes.entity.legalAddress. No industry field exists in LEI reference data.
